Integrated platforms
Analysis apps
Powers every workspace on this page
Terra

The cloud workspace platform behind Quillmere's workspaces. Spin up notebooks, run WDL workflows at scale, and collaborate on analyses without managing infrastructure. Terra is NIST 800-171 and NIST 800-53 compliant with a FedRAMP authorization, meeting the latest NIH Controlled Access Data Repository (CADR) and Genomic Data Sharing (GDS) Policy security updates.

WorkspacesWDL workflowsNotebooksFedRAMP authorizedNIST 800-53
Open Terra →
Cohort Compass

Build a study cohort by filtering participants on phenotype, ancestry, and data type across every Quillmere study you can access, then send the sample list straight to a workspace.

Cohort builderPhenotype filters
Open Cohort Compass →
Pinboard

A shared results board for your lab. Pin plots and tables from workspace runs, add notes, and keep a dated record of how each result was produced.

Results sharingLab notebook
Open Pinboard →
Quillmere Harmonization Service

Map phenotype variables from different studies onto one shared data dictionary, so blood pressure, smoking status, and 600 other measures line up across cohorts. Usage is free while the service is in preview.

Phenotype harmonizationFree during preview
Go to the Harmonization Service →

Four ways in
Explore by research area
Population Genomics & Pangenomics

Quillmere is a primary workbench for analyzing human genetic variation at scale across diverse groups of people. Instead of relying on a single linear reference genome, researchers use the Wrenfield pangenome, a multi-genome reference that captures the genetic diversity of the global population.

Pangenome referenceWrenfield
Explore population genomics datasets →
Clinical & Translational Science

Quillmere connects large datasets to patient care by giving clinicians and researchers tools to interpret genomic variation in real-world settings. That ranges from pharmacogenomics, which studies how genetic makeup shapes drug response, to polygenic risk scores (PRS) that combine thousands of variants into one risk estimate for conditions like heart disease and diabetes.

PharmacogenomicsPolygenic Risk Scores
Explore clinical & translational datasets →
Common & Mendelian Disease Genetics

Quillmere hosts data from research networks studying both ends of the genetic disease spectrum: complex, multi-gene conditions like heart disease and neuropsychiatric disorders through the Ashgrove Common Disease Centers, and severe single-gene disorders through the Lantern Rare Disease Network, which searches for rare variants to diagnose unexplained conditions.

Ashgrove CentersLantern RDN
Explore disease genetics datasets →
Functional Genomics

Sequencing DNA is the first step; scientists also need to know what genes do. Through the Variant-to-Function Initiative (VFI), researchers use Quillmere to study how genetic variation changes molecular function inside single cells, using CRISPR screens and single-nucleus sequencing (snRNA-seq and snATAC-seq).

VFICRISPR screenssnRNA-seq
Explore functional genomics datasets →
Thirteen consortia, four missions
Explore by research initiative
Functional Genomics & Reference Mapmakers
REGMAP
Regulatory Element Mapping Project

Maps the genome's non-coding regions, building a catalog of the regulatory switches that turn genes on and off.

VFI
Variant-to-Function Initiative

Picks up where REGMAP's maps stop, using single-cell sequencing and CRISPR screens to test how variants alter cellular function.

WRP
Wrenfield Reference Project

Builds a graph-based pangenome that captures the structural diversity of global populations, replacing a single linear reference.

GAPLESS
Gapless Genome Consortium

Sequenced the highly repetitive regions short reads miss, then reprocessed thousands of genomes on Terra against the finished reference.

Clinical Application & Risk Metrics
EQUIRISK
Equitable Risk Scores Consortium

Builds, tests, and tunes polygenic risk scores so multi-variant risk estimates stay accurate across diverse ancestry groups.

CRHN
Cobalt Ridge Health Network

Tests how to deliver genomic risk results directly into electronic health records so clinicians can use them in patient care.

QMOS
Coming 2027
Quillmere Multi-Omics Study

Combines genomic sequence with transcriptomics, environmental exposures, and clinical phenotypes to build molecular risk profiles for chronic disease.

Rare & Neurodegenerative Diseases
LRDN
Lantern Rare Disease Network

Uses long-read sequencing and broad data sharing to find the single-gene variants behind unresolved Mendelian disorders.

NUCN
Northbrook Undiagnosed Conditions Network

A clinical network of specialists working on ultra-rare conditions, with patient data hosted at Quillmere to support discovery.

FDGC
Fenmoor Dementia Genetics Center

Hosts long-read sequencing from ancestrally diverse brain samples to map the genetic and epigenetic landscape of dementia.

MND-H
Motor Neuron Disease Harmonization

Brings scattered whole-genome data from motor neuron disease cohorts into one uniform dataset on Terra.

Machine Learning & Infrastructure
QMLAB
Coming 2027
Quillmere Machine Learning Lab

Builds AI models to predict disease penetrance: why some people with a variant develop disease while others don't.

QCAP
Quillmere Capacity Partnership

Funds infrastructure and data-science training at under-resourced institutions to widen access to large-scale genomics.
